The vertical axis on the left side is labeled with the number of new COVID-19 patients, ranging from 0 to 1,800,000, while the vertical axis on the right side is labeled with the number of related media reports, ranging from 0 to 6,000. The chart shows fluctuations in both the number of new patients and media reports over the observed period, with some days experiencing higher numbers of new cases and media coverage. The chart does not provide any specific information about the reasons for these fluctuations or the correlation between the two variables.
